models.name: deposits
models.tenantJoin: JOIN users u ON u.id = deposits.created_by AND u.tenant_id = :tenant_id

models.name: monthly_payslips
models.tenantJoin: JOIN users u ON u.id = monthly_payslips.user_id AND u.tenant_id = :tenant_id

canonical_metrics.name: uncontacted_leads
canonical_metrics.sql_condition: ps.order_index IN (1, 2) AND (c.lead_status NOT IN ('lost', 'nurture') OR c.lead_status IS NULL) AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

canonical_metrics.name: qualified_leads
canonical_metrics.sql_condition: ps.order_index BETWEEN 3 AND 12 AND (c.lead_status NOT IN ('lost', 'nurture') OR c.lead_status IS NULL) AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

canonical_metrics.name: won_leads
canonical_metrics.description: Won / Chốt cọc & Nhập học (Pipeline Stages 13 - 14)
canonical_metrics.sql_condition: ps.order_index IN (13, 14) AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

canonical_metrics.name: official_students
canonical_metrics.sql_condition: (ps.order_index = 14 OR c.status = 'customer') AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

canonical_metrics.name: statutory_insurance_rates
canonical_metrics.description: Tỷ lệ trích nộp BHXH/BHYT/BHTN/KPCĐ theo chuẩn Luật Lao động
canonical_metrics.formula: NV đóng 10.5% (8% BHXH + 1.5% BHYT + 1% BHTN); DN đóng 23.5% (17.5% BHXH + 3% BHYT + 1% BHTN + 2% KPCĐ); Giảm trừ bản thân 11tr, NPT 4.4tr/người
